description: This file defines the WorkflowViewer class, which extends WorkflowCanvas to visualize workflows using jsPlumb. It manages connections, activity elements, and their interactions within a workflow diagram.

classes.name: WorkflowViewer
classes.description: A class extending WorkflowCanvas to visualize and manage workflow diagrams with jsPlumb, including connection handling and activity element configuration.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the WorkflowViewer, sets up jsPlumb, binds connection events, and configures activity elements.

methods.name: getEndpointColor
methods.description: Returns color based on activity properties (blocking or event).
